_provenance: Extraído literalmente de claude-design-system/readme.md §10 PRESENTATION DENSITY AND CONTENT LIMITS y §Density, Hito 1, 2026-07-23. slideContentLimits reproduce el bloque TypeScript ya definido en el propio readme.md — no se inventó ningún límite.

low.use: mensajes de alto nivel, cifras clave, títulos grandes, lectura inmediata

high.use: tablas, indicadores, contenido técnico — organizado, nunca saturado, jerarquía preservada

slideContentLimits._note: Guía visual, no un objetivo a llenar mecánicamente.

overflowResolutionOrder: never solve overflow by reducing body copy below 20px
never reduce the institutional logo below its minimum or recommended size to gain content space

rules: do not repeat one decorative element excessively
keep shapes simple and derived from the established system
avoid ornamental waves, textures or patterns behind dense content
use cards only when they organise information
use shadows sparingly and never on logos
the recurring corner wave must not overlap the logo protection area, appear on every content slide, compete with the title, be combined with additional decorative patterns, or reduce text contrast
